'''Zulay Ulor''' was a [[human]] who led [[Caracara Squadron]], a [[mercenary]] [[starfighter]] [[squadron]]. Ulor's squadron offered defense services to [[Star system|systems]] without their own [[fleet]]s, but had been chased out of restricted zones by both the [[First Order]] and [[New Republic]] prior to the outbreak of [[First Order-Resistance War|war]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Zulay Ulor wore a dark suit with a flight helmet in Caracara Squadron colors. She flew a refurbished [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-wing starfighter]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
